s: Din biur chametz ubo y"b seipim: keshem shemmin hattora, ap al pi shemmitchillat shaa z' hu mitzva shello yimmatze chametz birshuto, vekol rega verega shennimtza chametz birshuto veeno mitasseq lebaaro hu ober al mitzvat aseh shel tora, ap al pi ken eno mechuyyab lebaaro besop shaa shishshit kede shello yimmatze bitchillat z', ella mittechillat z' vaelak hu shemmechuyyab lebaaro — kak middibre soperim, ap al pi shemmitchillat shaa shishshit vaelak hu mitzva shello yimmatze chametz birshuto, vekol rega verega shennimtza chametz birshuto veeno mitasseq lebaaro hu ober al mitzvat aseh middibre soperim, ap al pi ken eno mechuyyab lebaaro besop shaa chamishit kede shello yimmatze birshuto bitchillat shaa shishshit, ella mittechillat shaa shishshit vaelak hu shemmechuyyab lebaaro (umikkol maqom, tob linhog lebaaro besop Hashem, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d). Veim rotzeh lebaer qodem shaa shishshit — eno tzarik lebaaro min haolam legamre, ella day lo bemah shemmebaaro mereshuto, dehaynu sheyyimkerennu lenokri o yittenennu lo bemattana gemura. Vaapillu im keshemmaggia zeman habbiur, dehaynu shaa shishshit, adayin hannokri machaziq chametzo bebet hayyisrael — en bekak kelum, veal derek shennitbaer besiman t"m. Veken im qodem shehiggia zeman habbiur hotzi hechametz mereshuto vehipqiro vehinnicho bemaqom shehu mupqar lakkol, kegon badderakim ubarechobot, shershut lekol adam laabor sham velittol hechametz, apillu im lo netalo shum adam vahare hu munnach sham kol yeme happesach ubealayv roin oto munnach sham — en tzarik lebaaro, kevan sheeno shello, shekkebar hipqiro, vegam munnach bemaqom sheeno shello, vehattora omra: "bekol gebuleka", ugebul zeh eno shello ella hepqer lakkol, ayyen siman tl"a:

Abal im hipqiro vehinnicho bemaqom sheeno mupqar lakkol, kegon shehinnicho bechatzer shehi meyuchedet leanshe hechatzer haddarim sham bilbad, veen shum adam yakol laabor shello birshutam, ap al pi shemmin hattora eno ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", shehare kebar hipqiro veeno shello keshemmaggia zeman habbiur, mikkol maqom middibre soperim chayyab lebaaro, dekevan sheim lo haya mapqiro qodem shehiggia zeman habbiur haya mechuyyab min hattora lebaaro kesheyyaggia zeman habbiur, shehare hu munnach bemaqom sheeno mupqar lakkol, vahare zeh keillu haya munnach bemaqom shehu shello mammash, mittaam shennitbaer besiman t"m, lepikak gam atta shehipqiro lo niptar miggezerat chakamim, shehare gazeru chakamim sheen bittul vehepqer moil lechametz hayyadua, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"a. Vaapillu hinnicho bemaqom hammupqar lakkol — tzarik sheyyapqirennu legamre bepiv ubelibbo, velo yihyeh bedato bishat hepqer lachazor velizkot bo leachar happesach im lo yeqaddemennu acher, sheim yesh bedato ken — eno hepqer gamur, vahare hu keshello mammash kol zeman shello zaka bo acher, kevan shehu yosheb umetzappeh shemma lo yizkeh acher veyizkeh bo hu:

Veim hu mebaer chametz bizman habbiur, dehaynu mittechillat shaa shishshit ad kelot yeme happesach — tzarik lebaaro min haolam legamre, velo day bemah shemmotzio mereshuto umannicho bimqom hepqer, shehare mishshehiggia shaa shishshit kebar neesar bahanaa veeno shello kelal, veap al pi ken hattora asaah oto keillu hu shello, sheyyaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", ulepikak ap keshemmotzio mereshuto hare hu ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", sheasaato hattora keillu hu munnach birshuto mammash. Veen lo taqqana ella sheyyebaarennu min haolam legamre, dehaynu sheyyashlikennu leibbud beinyan sheshshum adam lo yukal lehanot mimmennu. Veap al pi shebberiyyot acherot yekolot lehanot mimmennu, mikkol maqom kevan sheshshum adam lo yukal lehanot mimmennu — hare zeh niqra biur min haolam:

Ketzad mebaer? Sorepo ad shennaaseh pechamim (abal im lo naasa pecham, ap al pi shennecherak venipsal meakilat keleb — asur lehashhoto bepesach, kevan shello nipsal meakilat keleb ad leachar zeman habbiur, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b), o porero leperurin daqqim vezoreh oto laruach, o porer vezoreq lannahar, im hu pat vekayyotze bo sheim lo yeparerennu veyizreqennu lannahar o layyam hare hu shat al pene hammayim veyukal adam hamhallek bispina lehanot [mimmennu], abal keshemmeporero leperurin daqqim vezoreqo lammayim hare hen nimmosin venimmochin betok hammayim. Abal im haya hechametz perurin perurin, kegon chittim vekayyotze bahen — en tzarik leporeran od, ella mashlikan min hassaq letok hammayim vehen mitpazzerim mealehem al pene hammayim, velo yehaneh mehen shum adam. Veyesh machamirin bechittim o shear mine tebua lachtok kol echad veechad leb' o leg' chatikot veachar kak yashlikem lammayim, kevan shehem qashot veenan nimmosin betok hammayim. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem bemaqom sheepshar, kegon sheen sham ella meat chittim sheyyukal lechotkan beshaa muetet. Abal im hen harbeh sheyyitztarek lishhot harbeh bachatikatan o ad sheyyitchenem — en lehashhot hechametz bishbil kak (ubiprat im nitchammetzu leachar zeman habbiur, shello hayu biklal habbittul shemmebattel kol adam et chametzo besop shaa chamishit kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d, veim ken yesh issur min hattora lehashhotam). Veyesh lismok al sebara harishona:

Veim mashliko lebet hakkisse hare hu kimboar min haolam legamre, kevan sheshshum adam lo yukal od lehanot mimmennu. Veen tzarik leporero qodem shemmashliko, apillu hu pat vekayyotze bo. Ubilbad shello yashlikennu sham lipne chazir, sheasur lehaakil libhema apillu hi shel nokri o shel hepqer kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"g. Abal kesheeno mashliko sham lipne chazir, ap al pi shessopo leekol mimmennu — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno noten lepanayv leekol:
Mi sheyyesh lo mayim mekunnasin ubahem dagim — lo yashlik lesham hechametz shetztzarik lebaaro, apillu hu meporero qodem shemmashliko, shehare hu neheneh bemah shehaddagim yokluhu:

Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim shehechametz shetztzarik lebaaro min haolam legamre en biuro ella bisrepa, sheanu lemedin minnotar, mah notar yeshno be"bal totiru" vetaun serepa, ap chametz sheyyeshno be"bal totar" (perush "bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze") taun serepa. Vahalaka kassebara harishona, shehare neemar "vesarapta et hannotar baesh", vedareshu chakamim: hannotar taun serepa, veen kol issure hanaa shebbattora teunin serepa. Veap al pi ken hamminhag bimdinot ellu kassebara haacharona. Ulepikak nohagin shehechametz shemmotzein bibdiqat lel y"d en sorepin oto miyyad ballayla ella matzniin oto lesorpo lemachar bayyom, kede ledammoto lenotar shemmitzvato lesorpo bayyom, shenneemar "vehannotar mibbesar hazzabach bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissarep", velo ballayla. Ak im yirtzeh lisrop hechametz miyyad achar habbediqa kede shello yigreruhu qetannim o chulda veakbarim — hareshut beyado. Veim lo matza shum chametz bibdiqato — tob lisrop hakkeli shellaqach labbediqa, kede shello yishkach chobat habbiur leshana habbaa, vegam kede shello yishkach lebattel bittul hashsheni shennitbaer besiman tl"d:

Keshessorep hechametz leachar shehiggia shaa shishshit shehu asur bahanaa, tzarik laasot lo medura bipne atzmo, velo yashlikennu letok hattannur shemmassiqo leepot o lebashshel betoko, lepi sheasur lehanot mehechametz ap bishat biuro, leepot o lebashshel alayv, o lehishtammesh leoro, o lehitchammem kenegdo, vekayyotze bahen mishshear mine hanaot. Veap happechamim vehaeper shel hechametz asurim bahanaa. Abal happechamim vehaeper shel haetzim shessarepu bahen hechametz muttarim bahanaa im hu makkiran, sheyyodea beberur shehen mehaetzim velo mehechametz. Abal im nitarebu ellu beellu sheeno makkiran — hare kullan asurim bahanaa, veen happechamin vehaeper shel hechametz betelin apillu beelep shel hetter, shehare yesh lahem hetter hanaa belo bittul, dehaynu lehashhotan ad leachar happesach, vekol dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin apillu beelep lo batel. Abal muttar lekassot dam chayya veop beeper serepat hechametz, shemmitzvot lav lehanot nittenu, kelomar shello nittenu hammitzvot leyisrael lihyot qiyyumam hanaa lahem, ella leol al tzavvaram nittenu:

Veim hussaq hattannur bechametz veapa bo et happat o shebbishshel bo tabshil, ben sheapa ubishshel al gabbe haggechalim, ben sheapa ubishshel bechummo shel tannur leachar sheggarap et haggechalim — hare pat vetabshil zeh asurin bahanaa. Veim nitarebu baacherim kullan asurin bahanaa, veen lahem taqqana al yede pidyon deme hanaat hechametz sheyyashlik haddamim leibbud, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"y. Abal muttar lemokran lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbahen dehaynu sheyyenakkeh deme hanaat hechametz shehissiq bo hattannur middeme happat vehattabshil shennotel mehannokri, denimtza sheeno neheneh kelal mehechametz shehissiq bo. Raq sheyyizzaher leparer happat qodem sheyyimkerennu lannokri im hu maqom shennohagin hetter bepat shel akku"m, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tm"b. Vaapillu lo nitarebu pat vetabshil zeh baacherim — muttar lemokram kak. Veyesh mi sheoser im lo nitarebu. Vetob lachosh lidbarayv im en sham hepsed merubbeh velo sheat haddechaq:

Vekol zeh keshehussaq chametz harbeh betok hattannur sheyyesh behesseq zeh bilbad, belo hitztorput etzim kede leepot happat sheapa bo o kede lebashshel hattabshil shebbishshel bo, ap al pi shehissiq bo etzim harbeh kede shetteechoz bo haur yapeh, mikkol maqom kevan shelleachar sheachaza bo haur yesh behesseqo kede leepot happat o kede lebashshel hattabshil — hare hen asurin bahanaa. Abal im en behesseq hechametz kede leepot ulebashshel ella behitztorput haetzim, ap al pi sheggam behaetzim beatzmam en leepot ulebashshel ella behitztorput hesseq hechametz, mikkol maqom kevan shehetter veissur goremin leepot o lebashshel — hare pat vetabshil zeh muttarin apillu baakila. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheapa o bishshel mittechillat shaa shishshit ad hallayla, abal im apa o bishshel millel t"v vaelak, kevan shechametz betok happesach oser bemashshehu kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"z, lepikak ap al pi shehetter im issur goremin leepot ulebashshel — hare happat vehattabshil asurin bahanaa (ella im ken mokeran lenokri, chutz middeme issur shebbahem, kemo shennitbaer), shehare al kol panim yesh hanaat mashshehu mehechametz tok happat vetabshil. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim deen chilluq ben apa ubishshel tok happesach leapa ubishshel qodem happesach mishshaa shishshit vaelak. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh o bishat haddechaq, kegon letzorek simchat yom tob sheen lo maakalim acherim:

Vekol zeh keshemmebaer hechametz achar shehiggia shaa shishshit, abal keshemmebaaro qodem shaa shishshit shehu muttar bahanaa en tzarik laasot lo medura bipne atzmo, ella muttar lehassiq bo hattannur ulebashshel alayv, vekol shear mine hanaot. Vaapillu leachar shehiggia shaa shishshit muttar lehanot mimmennu im kebar nitcharek venipsal meakilat keleb qodem shaa shishshit. Umikkol maqom, nohagin laasot lo medura bipne atzmo apillu keshessorepin oto qodem shehiggia shaa shishshit:

Yesh nohagin lisrop et hechametz baaraba shechabetu otah behoshana rabba, lepi shekkol dabar shennaasa bo mitzva achat nakon laasot bah mitzva acheret. Veyesh nohagin laasot hesseq mearbot hallulab bepi hattannur bishat apiyyat hammatztzot:
